name: JetBlue
max_carrier_dimensions: 17 x 12.5 x 8.5 in (43.18 x 31.75 x 21.59 cm); soft- or hard-sided
checked_or_cargo: No large dogs accommodated; pets travel in the cabin only.
service_animal_note: Different policies apply to service animals (see JetBlue Accessibility Assistance).
notes: Max two pets per traveler, each in its own carrier; a second pet requires a second seat and pet fee. No seating in exit rows, bulkheads or Mint. Pet fee amount was not shown on the help page we fetched.
